decision.activation_reason: Hybrid is the frozen-holdout quality winner, but strict domain+level filtering materially reduces M1 exact-term ranking because foundational M3 chunks are level=unspecified; Hybrid's holdout gain over Vector is also too small to justify the extra complexity while it trails Vector on the preserved stress set.
decision.minimum_complexity_review: No complex architecture is adopted until a safe level strategy is frozen and Hybrid demonstrates a material paired gain over Vector on independent evidence.
decision.rule: A more complex retriever requires >=0.05 absolute Recall@5 or MRR@8 gain, no material exact-term loss, and best Recall@5.

lexical.implementation: production weighted lexical overlap + domain selection + exact-title bonus

frozen_configuration.objective_defined_before_tuning: lexicographic: Recall@5, MRR@8, Precision@5, shallower depth, no diversification, balanced weights, domain filter

identity.evidence_note: The prior hash appears only in the supplied milestone brief; checked-in M3 evidence was not rewritten.
